title: Garden of Understanding: Adam and Eve's Love Map
description: An intimate path where a gardener-steward and a truth-seeker discover what they can teach each other about tending the world
purpose: Build mutual understanding between partners through complementary teaching - each sharing their domain of passion with the other

chapters.title: In the Garden Together
chapters.description: Shared ground - the values, communities, and care practices that drew you together

steps.stepNarrative: You both believe that care work deserves recognition. Start here - in the shared conviction that tending to others has real value.
learningObjectives: Explore how care economy principles resonate with both partners
Identify shared values around visible, valued care work

steps.stepNarrative: The garden club is where your worlds overlap most naturally. Explore what community gardening reveals about how you each approach shared spaces.
learningObjectives: Understand what community gardening means to each partner
Discover shared approaches to tending shared spaces

steps.stepNarrative: What does it mean to build technology that serves love? Discuss how digital tools can strengthen rather than replace the care you give each other.
learningObjectives: Explore the intersection of technology and intimate care
Discuss how digital tools serve your relationship

steps.stepNarrative: Love itself is a technology - a way of knowing and shaping the world. Reflect together on how love organizes your shared life.
learningObjectives: Understand love as an organizing principle
Reflect on how love shapes your shared decisions

chapters.title: Tending and Naming
chapters.description: Adam teaches Eve - stewardship, ecology, naming, and the regenerative patterns he sees in the world

steps.stepNarrative: Adam, show Eve how you see value in the world. The value scanner perspective names what matters and measures what's real.
learningObjectives: Understand the value scanner domain through Adam's eyes
Learn how value recognition shapes stewardship

steps.stepNarrative: Adam, teach Eve about stewardship that cannot be corrupted - tending resources with integrity, the way you tend the garden.
learningObjectives: Understand principles of incorruptible stewardship
Connect stewardship to personal relationship values

steps.stepNarrative: Adam, walk Eve through the regenerative agriculture network - how soil health mirrors relational health, how patience yields abundance.
learningObjectives: Understand regenerative agriculture principles
Draw parallels between ecological and relational regeneration

steps.stepNarrative: Adam, share your long view - how you think about planting trees whose shade you may never sit in, and what that means for your family.
learningObjectives: Understand intergenerational thinking as a stewardship practice
Discuss how long-term vision shapes family decisions

chapters.title: Seeking and Questioning
chapters.description: Eve teaches Adam - truth-seeking, public observation, digital relationships, and the courage to question

steps.stepNarrative: Eve, show Adam how you see the world. The public observer watches, questions, and holds power accountable.
learningObjectives: Understand the public observer domain through Eve's eyes
Learn how critical observation strengthens communities

steps.stepTitle: Social Medium: Relationships in Digital Space
steps.stepNarrative: Eve, teach Adam about social medium - how digital communication can nurture genuine connection instead of shallow engagement.
learningObjectives: Understand the social medium domain through Eve's perspective
Explore how digital spaces can serve real relationships

steps.stepNarrative: Eve, share what genuine connection means to you - how you distinguish real presence from performative interaction, online and off.
learningObjectives: Understand the qualities of genuine connection
Discuss how authenticity shows up in your relationship

steps.stepNarrative: Eve, teach Adam how transparency protects communities - and relationships. How honest questioning is an act of love, not suspicion.
learningObjectives: Understand transparency as a protective mechanism
Discuss how honest questioning strengthens trust between partners

chapters.title: New Beginnings Together
chapters.description: Synthesis - bridging both perspectives into a shared vision for tending the world together

steps.stepNarrative: Together, explore an economy that generates value instead of extracting it. What would your household look like if it ran on these principles?
learningObjectives: Understand value-generative economics as a shared framework
Imagine household and family economics through this lens

steps.stepNarrative: A family is the smallest self-governing community. Discuss how the principles of community self-governance apply to your life together.
learningObjectives: Apply self-governance principles to family life
Design shared decision-making practices

steps.stepNarrative: You don't have to see the world the same way to tend it together. Celebrate your complementary perspectives - the gardener and the questioner need each other.
learningObjectives: Appreciate complementary perspectives in partnership
Identify how different values strengthen your shared life

steps.stepNarrative: Reflect on what you've learned about each other. Name one thing your partner taught you that changed how you see the world. This is your garden now - tend it together.
learningObjectives: Synthesize mutual learning into shared understanding
Commit to ongoing complementary growth
